package: ICC Plus Local rc14 compiler-boundary and sparse-runtime candidate
candidate_role: LLM-first ICC Plus 2.10.7 authoring and validation with explicit compiler/native ownership boundaries and behavior-preserving sparse Viewer runtime serialization

local_regression.normal_tests: CI workflow is authoritative for the current branch
local_regression.checked_in_examples: CI workflow is authoritative for the current branch

project_integrity.canonical_writes: hydrate and complete-validate in memory, then save the pinned sparse representation by default
project_integrity.compatibility_validation: normal saved-project validation is project validate; use --complete for explicit Creator completeness
project_integrity.identity_policy: hydration never invents missing entity identities
project_integrity.version_policy: older supported projects may upgrade to 2.10.7; future versions are never downgraded

compiler_boundary.native_layer: ICC Plus Local owns pinned native compatibility, validation, serialization, local simulation, explicit native edits, and reference integrity
compiler_boundary.source_compiler: source lowering owns semantic normalization such as Requirement hoisting, style-intent consolidation, taxonomy pruning, Row merging, Pick-N inference, and deterministic runtime-ID compaction/remapping

runtime_serialization.policy: normal saved project JSON and player-facing Viewer payloads omit every pinned 2.10.7 field currently proven behavior-equivalent when absent
runtime_serialization.non_sparse_opt_out: all full-project JSON outputs are sparse by default; --not-sparse / --not_sparse is the only opt-out on commands that write project JSON
runtime_serialization.verification_policy: unproven omissions require isolated pinned-Viewer baseline/candidate testing before promotion

style_policy.group_inheritance: Design Groups may link to normal ICC Plus Groups
style_policy.private_style_guard: one style-manifest item cannot apply private inline styling to multiple targets

agent_contract.normal_saved_project: sparse after successful Creator-complete in-memory validation
